similarityReview: The 3D model captures the iconic leaning pine tree and the smaller cherry blossom tree. The pine tree uses a conical trunk and multiple ellipsoid clusters to represent the layered foliage. The cherry tree is represented by a central trunk and smaller ellipsoid clusters for the blossoms. The scale is set to match a typical park setting.
